details:
Description

A serious and highly disruptive bug is occurring that forcibly closes the chat box.

The chat box is opened by pressing the Y key, but if the Y key is pressed while typing, the chat box is forcibly closed even though text is still being entered.

As a result, it is currently impossible to communicate properly through text chat.

This bug is extremely problematic and is preventing normal text-based communication.

Reproduction Steps

Pressing the **Y key on the keyboard while typing in the chat box will always forcibly close the chat box, regardless of the situation.
